name: Coaster

spine.record: Claim revision → Decision → Reimbursement batch → Accounting CSV

description: Employee expense claims with receipt evidence, manager approval, duplicate-safe reimbursement batches, an accounting CSV and an Expensify move-in kit, on the owner's own Cloudflare account.

externals.requiredWhen: MAIL_PROVIDER selects resend, sendgrid or cloudflare
externals.why: A hosted Coaster emails sign-in links, invitations, delegate-grant notices (ADMIN-005), questions about a claim (APPROVE-006), reminders and escalations (FOLLOWUP-001, FOLLOWUP-002), budget alerts (REPORT-004) and scheduled reports (REPORT-002) through the owner's own Resend, SendGrid or Cloudflare Email account; with no provider set nothing is sent, and Coaster on your own computer keeps mail in a local outbox.
data: Provider API key, sender and recipient email addresses

Message subject and text/HTML body: single-use sign-in and invitation links, the delegate's name and access level, the question asked with the claim number and title, a scheduled report's name, period and sign-in link (REPORT-002), a reminder naming the claim number and title, the one thing to do and a link to it (FOLLOWUP-001), an escalation of the same naming who owes it (FOLLOWUP-002), or a budget alert naming the budget, person, percentage reached and period, never amounts (REPORT-004)
Only on a report schedule the owner opts in: that report's figures as a CSV attachment, to finance, auditors or the owner

externals.why: Optional sign-in through the owner's own Auth installation (OpenID Connect); a blank answer keeps email-link sign-in, and nothing is sent until the owner links one.
data: Link handshake: Auth reads Coaster's public document (origin, name, callback, sector ID) and public signing key; Coaster redeems the one-use link code with its origin, callback, interface and a signed assertion

OpenID Connect: metadata and signing-key reads, the browser's authorization request, and code redemption with the PKCE verifier and a signed client assertion; Auth returns the signed-in person's email and name
No claim, expense, receipt, comment or member data is sent to Auth

deploy.notes: Native sessions guard /app and every /api/coaster route; agent keys reach only /api/coaster/agent; unknown paths return real 404s; the development outbox is local-only.
